decision.observation: The metal lever/bell fitting on the right gate post sparkles when beaked. If it's a bell, ringing it should summon the groundskeeper who opens the gate.
decision.hypothesis: Beaking the bell fitting rings it; the groundskeeper then walks over from beyond the gate and opens it, but may take 10+ seconds to arrive.
decision.memory: Sparkles at beak on that fitting means contact registered. Need a long wait after ringing.
